judgement.reason: Hermes Agent keeps its writable state (SQLite sessions, memory, skills) under a /opt/data volume, and Deployz has no persistent disk for it.

reviews.findingEvidence: Unsupported container setup: Dockerfile runs s6-overlay with 2 long-running services (dashboard, main-hermes) in one container. Deployz runs one web process and declared workers as separate services.
reviews.reason: The image uses s6-overlay to supervise the main hermes process and the dashboard in one container, and no shown line proves the dashboard is optional or disabled in production.

reviews.findingEvidence: Durable local filesystem state declared: VOLUME /opt/data (Dockerfile), volume ~/.hermes:/opt/data (docker-compose.yml gateway), volume ~/.hermes:/opt/data (docker-compose.yml dashboard)
reviews.reason: The Dockerfile states that writable state belongs under /opt/data, and no shown setting moves that state to PostgreSQL or S3, so the data would be lost on each restart.
